units.source_text: 柏木的出现方式很是唐突。

en.t: Kashiwagi's way of appearing was quite abrupt.

units.source_text: 他提出月色宜人，想在金阁上吹尺八，也是很唐突的。

en.t: His suggestion that the moonlight was pleasant and that he wanted to play the shakuhachi on the Golden Pavilion was also very abrupt.

units.source_text: 所有这一切都背叛了我所了解的柏木的形象。

en.t: All of this betrayed the image of Kashiwagi that I knew.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，对于我单调的生活，可以起到震动的作用。

en.t: Even so, it could serve to shake up my monotonous life.
For that alone, I was glad.

units.source_text: 我手里拿着他送给我的尺八，引领他走进了金阁。

en.t: Holding the shakuhachi he had given me, I led him into the Golden Pavilion.
